name: vision
source:
Liam, the main character, longs to become a writer and moves to the capital to go to school. While he is away, his father is killed in an accident, but his distant relatives continue to send him money to continue his schooling.

After he graduates, he returns to the family home to find no sign of the master of the house, but the master's second wife, daughter, and sister-in-law are there.
